rows.en: Yamato: "Hey, Touya. I think you know this, but
don't take replenishing Pranya too lightly."
Touya: "Replenishing?"
Yamato: "'Kissing'! 'Kissing'! You can't use it right away,
but you can once your Pranya gets low. That."
Touya: "Y-yeah... I know."
Yamato: "Really? A girl's lips aren't
something you can take so lightly, you knyow."
Touya: "I don't want to take it lightly either."
Yamato: "As long as you understand."
Touya: "All right, then... Here we go."
Horem: "So they've come after all... Hm?
I don't see Growster's mech..."
Steinies: "Maybe he croaked somewhere?"
Horem: "I doubt that.
He's the sort of man who could be left naked in a desert
and make it back alive through sheer willpower.
He won't die that easily."
Steinies: "Did that actually happen?"
Horem: "A little incident long ago.
He still seems to hold it against me..."
Steinies: "Y-you've done some crazy things...
Whatever. It's about time I headed out too."
Horem: "Oh, one more thing.
About that item... Please don't use it lightly.
It's quite precious."
Steinies: "I know.
You save your trump card for last. Hehehehehe.
You just sit here and enjoy the show."
Horem: "Hehehe... The bigger the fool, the easier to control...
Now, perhaps I should start preparing my escape.
I'd rather not get caught up in this..."
Vel: "Hey, Commander... Are we really going to fight?"
Vales: "...It's our contract."
Jono: "That... isn't like you."
Vales: "A heartless mercenary band.
Scum who'll take anyone's side for enough money...
I didn't care what people called us.
But I ran from the people I should have protected, and now
I'm trying to run away again..."
Vel: "...You mean your kids...?
But we don't know for sure they're dead yet."
Jono: "The shop had collapsed,
but their deaths haven't been confirmed."
Vales: "It doesn't matter. Even if they're alive,
I'm no longer their father as far as they're concerned."
Jono: "Commander..."
Vel: "...That's not true."
Vales: "..."
Vel: "Just as children will always be children to their parents,
parents will always be parents to their children.
Children lose their way because parents abandon their responsibilities.
What you're saying is just an excuse to run away, Commander.
What good will it do to decide you're not their father anymore?!"
Jono: "Hey..."
Vales: "No, Vel is right...
Perhaps I have been running away.
But it's too late now. For everything."
Vel: "Commander..."
Vales: "This contract isn't with the Solitary Silver Wings.
It's with me personally.
You don't have to go along with me."
Jono: "Commander... Don't shut us out like that.
We'll go with you."
Vel: "...It's not fair to hog
all the good parts. We can't miss
our commander's final performance."
Vales: "Heh... The price of admission is steep."
Vel: "Heh."
Jono: "...We've known that all along."
Vales: "...All right, let's go!"
Zigrim Soldier: "!!"
Touya: "...Hm?"
Yamato: "Something's nyot right..."
Zigrim Soldier: "Ugh... Ggh... Gah!"
Touya: "H-hey... What are you trying to do...?"
Zigrim Soldier: "G-g-g-g... Gah!"
Touya: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "Is this the self-destruction Reamond mentioned...?
Could those mechs use up
their pilots' Pranya if they don't fight...?"
Touya: "Who knows? But that's dealt with them for now.
Reamond and the others should handle the rest."
Touya: "Damn it! We didn't make it in time!"
Celica: "No way... Aidion?! What's going on!?
It was supposed to be completely dead...
Why is it moving?!"
?????: "I can't let you die here
along with them. Sorry, but you're coming with me..."
Steinies: "What!!"
?????: "Hehehe... Got you."
Steinies: "!!"
Valga: "I'm finished here too! Rishuna!"
Rishuna: "R-right! Here I go!"
Steinies: "Hehehe... I don't know who you are...
but you're too laaaaate!"
Rishuna: "I'm releasing the gravity field! Get back!"
Touya: "A-amazing..."
Rishuna: "..."
Touya: "...Hm?"
Touya: "Huh? I-it disappeared...?"
Yamato: "...Look, something's come out."
Touya: "Yeah... I've never seen that mech before."
Zigrim Soldier: "..."
Reamond: "Listen. That mech is called Rayal Klose.
It was developed alongside me."
Yamato: "Huh...? You mean it was your own special mech, or...?"
Reamond: "Yes. But that isn't the original. It's a mass-production model.
Still... To think that president had gone this far..."
Touya: "Anyway, that means it's an enemy, right?"
Reamond: "Yes. And I'd like you to destroy it if possible.
That mech should never have existed..."
Touya: "All right. I'll see what I can do."
Reamond: "I'm sorry. Its onboard system
feeds on life force, but it can convert tension and fighting spirit into
Prana. And the conversion efficiency is high, of course."
Yamato: "Pranya is biological energy, right?
Then..."
Reamond: "Yes. In effect, it can
keep fighting indefinitely."
Touya: "You've gotta be kidding..."
Reamond: "But it also puts a great strain on an inexperienced pilot.
If they don't attack, they may destroy themselves.
I'm sorry, but I'm counting on you!"
Yamato: "Hmm, but that might nyot happen, right?
It looks pretty strong, too. What a pain."
Touya: "We've got no choice. Let's do this!"
Steinies: "Tch... Time to use that... Hehehehe."
Steinies: "Wh-what?! Why isn't anything happening...?
!! Th-this is... Horem... You tricked me..."
Yamato: "!? Th-this is..."
Touya: "What's wrong?"
Yamato: "This pulse is from some kind of timer.
It's probably... No, it's definitely a bomb!
It's coming from that mech!
I don't know what kind it is, but if it explodes,
we won't get away unscathed either."
Touya: "Tch... So how long have we got?"
Yamato: "About three minutes. The detonator
seems to be connected directly to the main engine,
so if we can disable it before then..."
Touya: "All right, let's try it!
Yamato, can you tell where I should aim?"
Yamato: "Yes, leave it to me! But even the slightest mistake
could be dangerous, so disable it with Rayblade!"
Touya: "What happens if I screw up?"
Yamato: "Kaboom!"
Touya: "I-I see..."
Yamato: "So we'd better hurry."
Touya: "Got it! Everyone, you heard her.
I'll finish that bastard off! Cover me!"
Steinies: "...Hehehe... Keh heh heh...
Fine! I'll take this entire capital down with me!"
Touya: "Got it! Everyone... Wait, I'm
the only one left...?"
Growster: "Hey, boy! Don't worry about us!
Focus on stopping him first!"
Touya: "...Got it!"
Touya: "Got it! Everyone... Wait, I'm
the only one left...? What about Lodis and the others...?"
Growster: "Hey, boy! We're leaving that one to you!"
Lodis: "We'll continue on to the presidential residence."
Rest: "Don't worry about us."
Touya: "A-all right, got it... I'm counting on you!"
Rest: "Understood."
Growster: "Knowing him, he must already
be getting ready to run! This way!"
Fores: "Ah! Y-Your Excellency?!"
Reamond: "I don't think we need to worry...
His instincts at a time like this are better than a wild animal's.
Come on, let's go too."
Rest: "Your Majesty, we should go too!"
Lodis: "Yes."
Lodis: "Oh? Where might you be going?"
Horem: "W-well, if it isn't His Majesty King Lodis...
You needn't have gone to all the trouble
of coming to such a shabby place..."
Lodis: "Not at all. I've come today because I have
a private matter to discuss with you, President Horem."
Growster: "Give it up already!"
Reamond: "We know all about your plans.
Stop this foolishness right now!"
Horem: "Reamond Dalaim... I see. You're the final
product of that experiment. You've concealed your identity well.
Most impressive."
Reamond: "Wiping out Code 3...
That's the only thing I've lived for.
It wasn't easy getting this far..."
Horem: "Code 3's objective was splendid.
But the approach wasn't smart.
That method took far too long."
Growster: "Hmph! Perfect soldiers who obey
every order without question...? Rubbish! Soldiers hone themselves in battle,
talk with their comrades and grow.
Those puppets of yours are no use at all!"
Horem: "Are you quite sure of that?"
Growster: "Hm?! Who goes there!?"
Adjutant: "..."
Growster: "Y-you..."
Reamond: "...So you'd already made your move..."
Horem: "I thought I couldn't simply sleep forever.
I'm just getting ready to wake up."
Reamond: "But you've made two grave mistakes."
Horem: "Oh, have I? I don't think so."
Reamond: "The first... A person's heart
isn't so easily changed."
Horem: "Hehehe... All I hear is
the whining of a sore loser..."
Reamond: "...Is that so?"
Growster: "...Shoot."
Adjutant: "..."
Growster: "I can't shoot you.
And I'm not going to make myself your twins' enemy.
...I don't want to lose any more friends."
Horem: "What are you doing?! Sh-shoot!"
Growster: "You were the finest staff officer I ever had..."
Adjutant: "...Ugh... Y-Your Excellency..."
Horem: "Wh-what..."
Adjutant: "......I-I'm back..."
Growster: "Yes. You're as quick to tears as ever."
Adjutant: "...Ugh... Your Excellency..."
Horem: "Wh-why!? The drug's effects should have been perfect!"
Reamond: "...The feelings deep within a person's heart
can't be changed by something as superficial
as that masterpiece you're so proud of... That's why."
Horem: "Impossible... My... That drug is perfect!
The human heart?! I don't believe in anything so vague!"
Horem: "E-even if I die here,
the fighting won't end!"
Lodis: "What do you mean?"
Horem: "S-stay back! I'll shoot!"
Lodis: "Then shoot. But first,
I'd like you to tell me what you mean."
Horem: "Hehehe... V-very well.
Cain... He's in Agarthia right now."
Lodis: "Tix..."
Horem: "Th-that's right! He's gone to get
the prince again! You were careless!"
Lodis: "Heh... Did you think I'd leave Tix behind
without taking any precautions?"
Horem: "Wh-what... Impossible...
Are you saying you predicted our moves?!"
Lodis: "Nothing so grand. Just insurance.
Very powerful insurance at that."
Horem: "Guh..."
Fores: "Mr. President, lower your gun!"
Horem: "Heh... Hehehehehe... Hahahahaha!
It seems I've made quite a fool of myself. But I'm not wrong!
I did it for this world... Hehehe...
The ignorant masses don't understand my greatness!
That I am supreme!
That everyone other than me is garbage!
Hahahahaha! Diiiiie!!"
Horem: "Gah!!!!"
Lodis: "..."
Rest: "Your Majesty!"
Lodis: "Don't worry. It only grazed me."
Fores: "..."
Reamond: "...The second mistake.
You never trusted anyone.
People can't live alone, Mr. President..."
Vales: "...They've broken into the presidential residence...
It seems it's time... All right, we're withdrawing!"
Steinies: "Tch... Coward... Whatever.
You don't often get a battle like this!
Hehehe, I haven't felt this thrill in ages... Keh heh heh."
Growster: "Knowing him, he must already
be getting ready to run! This way!"
Fores: "Ah! Y-Your Excellency?!"
Reamond: "I don't think we need to worry...

Touya: "All right!"
Touya: "Hey, just where do you think you're going?"
Growster: "Abandoning your allies and running away alone...
Just what I'd expect from you."
Horem: "Guh... W-well, if it isn't Growster...

Touya: "Yamato, how is it?!"
Yamato: "...It's okay. It's stopped."
Touya: "Phew... That's one less thing to worry about."
Touya: "Now then... Hey, Steinies!
Hurry up and eject!"
Steinies: "Hehehe... I see...
...I thought you weren't fighting at full strength... Hehehehe...
And now you tell me to eject?
...What a softie..."
Touya: "Quit whining and eject already!"
Steinies: "Keh heh heh... To think that softie

I'm so pathetiiiiiic!!"
Touya: "H-hey!"
Steinies: "I... Iiiii...

Touya: "...Y-you idiot..."
Yamato: "Ah!"
Touya: "H-hey, don't tell me..."
Steinies: "Hehehe... Keh heh heh..."
Vales: "I've no grudge against you, but to give myself a fitting end,
I'll have you fall with me..."
Gen: "Heh! If you think you can beat me...?!
Th-this feeling... Somewhere, long ago..."
Vales: "Letting your mind wander in battle...? Hmph!"
Gen: "W-whoaaaa!!"
Touya: "Are you okay!?"
Rosalie: "Hey, Touya! Keep a proper eye on him!"
Touya: "Hey, don't ask the impossible.
Besides, Rosalie, you..."
Vales: "?!"
Gen: "Hm? He stopped moving? This is my chance!"
Vales: "Guh!"
Gen: "Tch!"
Gen: "Wh-what? He's opening a channel...
Hehe, does that mean he recognizes me as a worthy opponent?
All riiight, I'll open mine too..."
Vales: "...A child... Just as I thought...
Boy, tell me your name."
Gen: "Hehehe, you want to know my name? You've got
a good eye, old man! All right, I'll make an exception and tell you.
My name... is Genzbariored Mercene.
Think you can remember it?"
Vales: "Mercene... So it is you... Hehehe...
Genzbariored..."
Gen: "What's wrong, old man?"
Vales: "Nothing. Now, Gen,
show me what you can do!"
Gen: "Hey, he cut me off... What a selfish old man...
But... Why did he call me Gen...?"
Gen: "Old man!"
Vales: "..."
Gen: "Hey, you can hear me, right?!
Why'd you call me Gen just now?"
Vales: "We're in battle.
Don't think about anything else while you're fighting!
Focus on what's in front of you! Or your back will... again..."
Gen: "My back...? How do you know about that...?
!! C-could you be... Dad?"
Vales: "..."
Gen: "You're my dad, aren't you?!
You know about the scar on my back..."
Vales: "Your father...
Gaizardingterius Jin Mercene is dead."
Gen: "What are you talking about?! You're my dad, aren't you!?"
Steinies: "Hey, Commander... What are you dragging this out for?
I'll give you a hand..."
Vales: "!! W-wait!"
Steinies: "...Oh... So that story was true..."
Vales: "This was supposed to be a private transmission...
Does that mech have that much capability...?"
Steinies: "Who cares about that?
We're all going to die soon anyway! Keh heh heh..."
Vales: "..."
Steinies: "...But I'll go down as the man who defeated Crimson Gaius.
That'll give me a glorious end... A fine parting gift...
Hehehe."
Vales: "...You bastard..."
Steinies: "You know what this mech can do, don't you, huh?
All you can do is sit there and let me beat you!"
Steinies: "I'd prefer you call it surveillance...
But to think you were Crimson Gaius...
Hehehe... Now I've got a fine parting gift..."
Vales: "...You bastard..."
Steinies: "Hehehe... I'll make a name for myself...
You know what this mech can do, don't you, huh?

Vales: "Guh..."
Gen: "Dad could never lose to the likes of you!"
Steinies: "Hehehe... You don't seem to understand
that your very presence puts your father in a bind!
He can't move precisely because you're here."
Gen: "What are you talking..."
Steinies: "If I get serious, I can kill you
first... That's what I mean."
Gen: "D-Dad..."
Vales: "..."
Steinies: "Keh heh heh heh."
Gen: "Dad!"
Vales: "Gen..."
Vales: "Gah!"
Gen: "D-Dad! Why didn't you dodge?!
You shouldn't have worried about me..."
Vales: "...I can't let anyone dear to me

Gen: "...Dad..."
Vales: "...I'm sorry..."
Gen: "Dad!"
Vales: "...You've grown so much... Gen......"
Gen: "D-Dad... Dad... Daaaaaaad!!"
Steinies: "Hehehe... Keh heh heh heh..."

review_batches.context: Entire member read plus s_01c 0-44 and relevant glossary/library identity evidence. Starts with nonexplicit Prana kiss warning, Horem/Steinies preparations, Vales's despair and comrades' reply, then conditional Soldier collapse and rescue events.
review_batches.decisions: Retain Pranya quirk only in Yamato, brief nonexplicit kiss mechanism without added intimacy, Horem's desert anecdote and mercenary contract scope. Daughter plus associative -tachi refers to children as a group in profile context, not evidence of another daughter. No deaths inferred from unconfirmed collapse.

row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o00452.l01: Pranya remains Yamato's approved speech quirk, not separate energy source.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o004a8.l00: Brief kissing is nonexplicit mechanic; availability condition retained, no sexual details added.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o00501.l00: Lips warning says not to take kiss lightly; it is not a literal monetary price.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o005d3.l00: Croaked carries Steinies's dismissive death speculation, not confirmed death.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o005f7.l01: Naked desert abandonment is nonsexual harsh anecdote; actual past incident implied by following question/reply.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o0066c.l01: Growster still holds it against Horem, not the reverse.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o006dd.l01: That-item intentionally unnamed until later contextual evidence; no premature bomb identity insertion.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o00778.l00: Horem's control claim is his contemptuous judgment, not narrator instruction.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o0083b.l00: Contract obligation is Vales's reason, not proof whole band's contract; personal scope is clarified later.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o0086b.l00: Heartless-mercenary-band is intentional quoted-reputation fragment, completed by discussion of labels.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o0086b.l01: Scum label retained at source force, not softened to morally flexible professionals.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o008e1.l00: Daughter plus associative -tachi can include daughter's companions/family, not necessarily multiple daughters. Library 057 confirms Rosalie and Gen as Vales's children; render kids in context, no second daughter invented.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o008e1.l01: Death unconfirmed; do not turn collapsed shop into confirmed casualties.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o0094c.l01: No-longer-father is Vales's self-rejection, not denial of biological relationship.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o009c7.l00: Vel argues reciprocal enduring family bonds; not an adopted-versus-biological distinction.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o009c7.l04: Addresses Vales choosing to cease being parent; not child rejection.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o00a79.l02: Too-late is Vales's despairing claim, not narrator confirmation.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o00ad4.l00: Personal contract distinct from Solitary Silver Wings band contract.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o00b26.l00: Do-not-shut-us-out carries objection to treating close comrades like strangers.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o00b59.l01: Final-performance metaphor and admission-price reply retained, not a literal show.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o00bd3.l00: We've-known restores subject/predicate of Jono's assent.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o00c71.l00: Punctuation-only startled reaction kept as nonempty.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o00d83.l00: Yamato asks whether it is self-destruction, not certain diagnosis or assumed suicide intent.
row_decisions.scenario.s_020.o00d83.l01: Pilot Pranya consumption without fighting remains her hypothesis, carried across boundary into row 80.

review_batches.context: Entire member read. Continues alternate Soldier self-destruction, Aidion/unknown rescuer, Rayal Klose explanation and timed-bomb battle alternatives.
review_batches.decisions: Preserve hypotheses versus claims, five-question-mark identity, mass-produced versus original mech, pilot life force and fighting tension as fictional system, roughly three minutes and requirement for Rayblade. No real bomb design, drug protocol or additional engineering details are supplied or added.
